decisions.reason: reviewed.skill_name.6b9641d2417b (光明→Ánh sáng) has no exclude_source_contains for the compound proper name 目白光明 (Mejiro Bright), so the live TranslationQualityGuard hard-requires literal 'Ánh sáng' even though 光明 here is only part of the verified character's official Roman name, not the standalone Skill/system label. 'Mảnh của/Mejiro Bright' (with or without 'của') is the semantically correct rendering, but any text satisfying the guard would corrupt the proper name (e.g. inserting 'Ánh sáng' into the character name). This is a systemic term-registry scoping bug, not a one-off; deferring instead of forcing an invalid literal match.

canonical_finding.concept: reviewed.skill_name.6b9641d2417b (光明→Ánh sáng) overmatches inside the verified character proper name 目白光明 (Mejiro Bright); needs an exclude_source_contains entry for 目白光明 (or character-name context scoping) in glossary/term_registry.json.
